handbook.controls.title: Controls & Shortcuts
handbook.controls.body:
Every shortcut uses its physical key position so English QWERTY and Russian JCUKEN match key-for-key. Hold Alt at any time to project paper keycaps directly onto visible HUD buttons.

## Mouse schemes
Switch live in Settings -> Interface between Age of History (LMB drag pans, MMB box selects, Ctrl+LMB selects regions) and Paradox (LMB box selects, MMB/RMB drag pans). In both schemes, a right-click past 8 px and 120 ms smoothly pans the map without issuing an accidental march order.

## QuickAmount & Everywhere
Popups and numeric actions share quarters (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) on A S D F only while focused with a blue ring. Closing with Enter, Esc, or a map click immediately returns WASD to the camera.

Shift+click (or right-click when enabled) on quick build or recruit actions executes across all eligible regions, and Ctrl+Z undoes the unstarted remainder until your next order.
